offering_description.value: Mines and processes lithium into battery-grade chemicals sold to battery cell and cathode makers, mainly under long-term supply contracts, for electric vehicles and grid energy storage.

primary_products.value: lithium hydroxide; lithium carbonate; battery-grade lithium compounds

customer_segment.value: B2B: battery cell makers, cathode producers, automakers and energy storage system integrators

end_markets.value: electric vehicles; grid energy storage; consumer electronics

revenue_model.value: product sales: lithium chemicals sold under long-term supply contracts

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: extracts lithium from brine and hard rock, sold to battery material makers; OEM / manufacturer: converts lithium into refined chemicals, sold to battery cell and cathode makers

geography_served.value: global: operations in the United States, Chile, China and Australia, with customers across Asia, Europe and North America

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: long-term contracts with battery and automotive supply chain customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: mining, water and chemical processing permits, plus environmental and export control rules

offering_description.value: Extracts bromine and makes derivative chemicals sold to plastics and electronics makers, oil and gas drilling operators and water treatment customers.

customer_segment.value: B2B: plastics and electronics manufacturers, oil and gas drilling companies, water treatment operators

end_markets.value: electronics; plastics; oil and gas; water treatment

revenue_model.value: product sales: bromine and derivative chemicals sold to industrial customers

geography_served.value: global: plants in the United States and Jordan, with sales to customers across Asia, Europe and the Americas

specialization.value: related lines: bromine, flame retardant and drilling fluid lines sharing bromine chemistry
